scope: Focused semantic review of the ec02c12 W17 result-table and dataset-inspect delta only.

entries.responsibility: Typed W17 dataset inspection and result table CRUD/readback.

findings.change: create and set now perform one final readback over every requested real matrix, imaginary matrix, and header value after all setters; create additionally proves the actual native tag and type. Empty create verifies identity without requiring invented table rows.
semantic_evidence: _table_matrix_matches performs exact value and shape comparison.
_table_definition_targets combines all requested fields into one target-scoped readback.
_table_final_write_check converts a readable mismatch to READBACK_MISMATCH and an unreadable result to EXECUTION_STATE_UNKNOWN.
A final read catches data corruption introduced by a later header setter.
findings.boundary: Offline fake-engine and public classifier evidence only; native COMSOL TableBaseFeature behavior remains pending live acceptance.

findings.change: Explicit imaginary writes require a readable isComplex=True proof. Real-only writes require native isComplex=False or an exact all-zero imaginary readback when the flag is unavailable. Complex imaginary read failure or shape mismatch remains unreadable and is exposed by get/list.
semantic_evidence: A native false complex flag is accepted as real-only proof even when optional getImag is absent or irrelevant.
A zero-imaginary proof uses the actual getImag value and exact matrix comparison; no zero matrix is fabricated for an unreadable getter.
Unscoped get/list responses retain match=None and now publish unreadable status/readback evidence instead of silently presenting real-only data.
findings.boundary: The zero-imaginary branch proves only table storage/readback semantics; it is not a numerical or scientific validation.

findings.change: dataset_inspect now reuses _resolve_dataset_binding, publishes the resolved solution only when the complete binding is proven, and exposes upstream dataset edges separately. It records per-property getter outcomes, property-inventory availability, a bounded 50-property snapshot, truncation, inspection_complete/incomplete, binding_complete, and read_errors.
semantic_evidence: A derived dataset data reference is returned as upstream_reference/upstream_references and is not copied into solution.
An unresolved binding returns solution=null with binding_complete=false and explicit errors.
Partial read-only inspection remains usable: metadata incompleteness does not set execution_state_unknown; only an unreadable core type does so.
Absent optional properties are not treated as failures when the native inventory and graph resolver establish that they are not published.
findings.boundary: Inspection completeness is metadata evidence only; it does not certify a solved model, field values, numerical correctness, or physical acceptance. Native property inventories and release-specific dataset behavior remain live gates.

open_limitations: No COMSOL engine or native worker was started for this semantic review.
The source still relies on release-specific native table and dataset accessor behavior that offline fakes cannot establish.

entries.responsibility: Focused contract regressions for W17 table and dataset behavior, including public domain classification of table outcomes.

findings.change: The test file exercises successful table create/set responses through the public classifier and asserts that late header-induced data corruption is classified as a failure, alongside exact complex/real-only, empty identity, unreadable get/list, and dataset inspection cases.

Tests cover derived dataset solution resolution, separate upstream references, getter failure diagnostics without raising, and unresolved datasets returning null solution while remaining usable read-only introspection.

validation.scope: Focused software tests; no full-suite or native-engine claim.

open_limitations: Fixtures do not prove all COMSOL 6.4 native table/dataset variants.
Passing tests do not promote table persistence, fresh-worker reopen, or numerical/physical acceptance.

acceptance_boundary.software_contract: The current bounded source/test delta is semantically reviewed and focused tests pass.
acceptance_boundary.zero_imaginary_proof: Requires actual readable getImag data whose cells compare exactly to zero; no synthetic zero is accepted.
acceptance_boundary.dataset_inspection: Partial diagnostics and binding/inventory completeness are introspection metadata, not numeric-result certification.
